### Checklist

- [ ] The `.st2` file is placed in the `terrains/` folder.
- [ ] The metadata is filled in (Name, Author, Version, Description) and the preview image is included.
- [ ] I've tested the map and it's playable in-game.
- [ ] The `Author` credit is correct.
